text: My daily routine is very important to me because it keeps me organised. Every morning, I wake up at seven o'clock, brush my teeth, and have a healthy breakfast. Then I start work at nine and usually finish around five in the afternoon. After work, I go to the gym or go running in the park to stay fit. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a film, or read a book before going to bed. I try to follow the same schedule every day, because consistency helps me feel calm, healthy, and ready for the next day.
